contacts.emailNote: Publicly listed in Milbank's 2025–2026 summer associate directory, page 17. Deliverability not tested.
contacts.personal: I saw that you received the Susman Godfrey Prize at Yale this year. Congratulations on that as well — it would be great to hear about your move from the Navy into law.
contacts.subject: Congratulations on ELP 2026 — hello from ELP 2025
contacts.message:
Hi Justin,

Congratulations on being selected for ELP 2026! I'm Hiro Kuwana, from the ELP 2025 cohort, and wanted to say hello.

I saw that you received the Susman Godfrey Prize at Yale this year. Congratulations on that as well — it would be great to hear about your move from the Navy into law.

I'm based in Tokyo, and please feel free to use me as a resource if you need anything here — local suggestions, introductions, or help figuring something out with ELP. You can reach me on WhatsApp or iMessage at +1 203 219 0391.

My one piece of advice from last year's program: make time for each other, including outside the formal sessions. Those relationships are what you get to keep.

Would be lovely to meet at the conference!

Hiro
